# Slop Mop

> A browser extension that reads your feed ahead of you and folds away low-value posts ("slop"), whether a person or an AI wrote them, and shows why. Not an AI detector: a bad-writing detector. Free for one feed; live on LinkedIn.

## Start here
- [Slop Mop in brief](https://slopmop.lol/ask-ai.md): what it is, how it works, who it's for, pricing, privacy, press
- [How it works](https://slopmop.lol/how-it-works.html): the nine tells, the counter-signals, the score
- [About](https://slopmop.lol/about.html): canonical product information

## Reports
- [State of Slop](https://slopmop.lol/state-of-slop): always the latest monthly report on how much of what people scroll past is slop, the signs that show up most and when slop peaks
- [State of Slop, October 2026](https://slopmop.lol/reports/state-of-slop-october-2026): one LinkedIn post in five was slop, 27 September to 27 October 2026
